note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.
prepare: if (-not (Get-ChildItem C:\MGLab\tools\deneb\*.pbiviz -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $assets = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/deneb-viz/deneb/releases/tags/2.0.0.0).assets | Where-Object name -like '*.pbiviz'; $a = @($assets | Where-Object name -like '*standalone*') + @($assets) | Select-Object -First 1; Invoke-WebRequest $a.browser_download_url -OutFile (Join-Path C:\MGLab\tools\deneb $a.name) }

screens.name: viz-report-overview
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\ContosoSales.pbip and Refresh; Design > Import theme > src\themes\ContosoBikes.json if the blue first series (#0B5CAD) is missing
Page Sales overview, Year slicer = 2025
Check cards: Sales amount 967,472.88, Sales growth vs prior year 8.1%, Orders 1,268; line chart, bar chart (Bikes > Accessories > Clothing), products table, empty cell bottom right
Optional second take: View > Selection > Tab order visible (3 cards, slicer, line, bar, table)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: viz-target-bullet
steps: File > Options and settings > Options > Current file > Report settings: Develop a visual on (this session)
Visualizations pane ... > Import a visual from a file > C:\MGLab\power-bi\*.pbiviz > Import
Add Target Bullet in the free cell (x 648, y 432, 608 x 264); Category = Product[Category], Actual = Sales Amount, Target = Sales PY; title Sales vs prior year by category
Year = 2025: Accessories up +8.4%, Bikes up +9.0%, Clothing circle -3.0%
Format pane > Bands: On-target tolerance (%) = 5, then set 2: Clothing turns down marker -3.0%
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: viz-deneb
steps: Same session as viz-target-bullet (ContosoSales.pbip open, refreshed, theme applied)
Off camera: open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\deneb\target-bullet.vl.json in Notepad, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C

Visualizations pane ... > Import a visual from a file > type C:\MGLab\tools\deneb\<the .pbiviz prepare printed> > Open > Import > OK (no sign-in; do NOT use Get more visuals / AppSource, that needs an account)
Add a page 'Deneb'; copy the Year slicer from Sales overview (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V; answer Sync if asked) and set 2025
Insert the Deneb visual, about 900 x 360; Values: Product[Category], then Sales Amount, then Sales PY (display names must stay exactly Category, Sales Amount, Sales PY)
Visual header ... > Edit > Create new specification: [empty] template, Vega-Lite > Create (labels may differ slightly in 2.0; any empty Vega-Lite start works, the paste replaces it)
Specification tab: select all, paste (Ctrl+V), Ctrl+Enter (Apply): three rows, Bikes +9.0% and Accessories +8.4% with up triangles, Clothing circle -3.0%, a dark tick at the prior year; hold
Back to report; hold on the page. Optional: hover a bar for the tooltip
Close without saving into the repo copy (or delete the Deneb page)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in the import file dialog (type the C:\MGLab path in the File name box, do not browse the nav pane)

screens.name: viz-high-contrast
steps: Settings > Accessibility > Contrast themes > Night sky > Apply (Desktop picks it up automatically)
Show the page: Target Bullet bars outlined in the foreground colour, markers and percentages visible, core visuals also in high contrast
Switch the contrast theme back to None
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

teardown: # Deneb .pbiviz stays in C:\MGLab\tools\deneb; to remove: Remove-Item C:\MGLab\tools\deneb -Recurse -Force
owner_notes: Local only. Windows contrast theme must be set back to None after hcscreen. Node 24 builds the visual (needs 20.19+). viz-deneb: Deneb 2.0.0 (free, MIT) standalone .pbiviz downloaded by prepare into C:\MGLab\tools\deneb from the GitHub release (no admin, no AppSource sign-in). Record it before viz-high-contrast so the contrast theme is off.
